result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.subgraph()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Extract an induced subgraph containing the specified nodes. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L12711-L12778){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.subgraph(nodes) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Returns a new graph containing only the specified nodes and all edges between them (the induced subgraph). This is a direct method that doesn't require prior selection, unlike `transform_to_subgraph_ws()`. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [nodes]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [list[int]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : List of node IDs to include in the subgraph. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : New graph containing only the specified nodes and edges between them. Preserves directedness, weightedness, and node labels. Edge weights are preserved. ::: ## Raises {.doc-raises} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [ValueError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If any node ID is not found in the graph. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Extract a subgraph from a path graph: ::: {#d1f98451 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec # Create a path: 1 -- 2 -- 3 -- 4 -- 5 graph = ec.Graph().add_path_graph(5) # Get node IDs node_ids = list(graph.get_node_ids()) # Extract subgraph of nodes at positions 1, 2, 3 (middle nodes) middle_nodes = node_ids[1:4] sub = graph.subgraph(middle_nodes) # Returns 3 sub.count_nodes() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 3 ``` ::: ::: ::: {#49aac785 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Returns 2 sub.count_edges() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` 1 ``` ::: ::: Extract a clique from a larger graph: ::: {#3c688b6a .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ec.Graph().add_full_graph(5) # K5 # Extract K3 subgraph node_ids = list(graph.get_node_ids())[:3] k3 = graph.subgraph(node_ids) # Returns 3 k3.count_edges() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ``` 3 ``` ::: :::
